title: Learning drums on Sam's drums and a Victrola
summary: He picked up drums practicing on sticks, Victrola records and Sam's drums, with no lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Did you...when you took up drums, did you have any lessons? Did your father help you or any...

No, no, no one learned how to play the drums. And in later years, in later years when I was...first band we organized was Lawrence on banjo, Adam Morrell on the bass, which is Lawrence's brother, cousin of mine. He's still living.
